entities.name: Saiba Futurists
entities.description: A secretive technocratic elite of Humans and Soratami in Otawara on Kamigawa, at the forefront of technological innovation.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane on which the Futurists work.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: Place on modern-day Kamigawa where the Saiba Futurists work.

entities.name: Veilshapers
entities.description: Agents of espionage employed by secretive Futurist divisions to keep secrets from reaching outside ears.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: Traditional rulers of Kamigawa who objected to Futurist technology and blamed them after the emperor vanished.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: Figure under whose guidance the Imperials governed the plane.

entities.name: Akki artisans of Sokenzanshi
entities.description: Skilled akki artisans who created enhancers that amplified individual abilities.

entities.name: Sokenzanshi
entities.description: Home of the akki artisans who created enhancers.

entities.name: Tameshi
entities.description: Futurist prodigy who discovered a way to connect tech and kami.

entities.name: Reality Chip
entities.description: Device whose discovery proved the Futurists were pursuing illegal bio-enhancements that affect the physics of reality.

events.summary: The Futurists, experimenting with merges to test the spirit realm, discover how to draw on magic directly without bonding with kami.
events.quote: they discovered a way to draw on magic directly, without needing to form a bond with kami

events.summary: Enhancers and Futurist techniques combine to spark a boom in new technology across the plane.
events.quote: these two technologies soon combined to form the basis of the boom in new technology

events.summary: After the emperor vanishes, the Imperials blame the Futurists for the attack.
events.quote: After the emperor vanished, the Imperials blamed the Futurists for the attack.

events.summary: Tameshi discovers a way to connect tech and kami.
events.quote: The Futurist prodigy Tameshi had discovered a way to connect tech and kami

events.summary: The Reality Chip is discovered, confirming rumors of illegal bio-enhancements.
events.quote: This proved to be true when the Reality Chip was discovered.

relations.note: the Imperials objected to Futurist technology
relations.quote: The Futurist development of cutting-edge technology was objected to by the more traditional Imperials .
